role: Stage D operator-conditioned sparse viscosity inverse on the Stage A harder Burgers pilot. This file is the scoring contract. It is not a test table.

hard_ood.name: hard_ood
hard_ood.complement: instances in the scored split with nu > threshold_nu

nu_search.grid: linspace(min, max, n_grid), both endpoints included

estimator.name: sparse_rollout
estimator.spatial_lift: real FFT zero-pad from the 32 sensors onto the trajectory grid; the coarse Nyquist coefficient is halved before padding

initial_window.frames_0_to_4: lifted burst that starts at frame 0
initial_window.frames_5_to_7: degree-2 Newton extrapolation of lifted frames 2, 3, and 4

estimator.rollout: autoregressive FNO; each predicted block is the next input; stop at the block that contains the last masked frame
estimator.nu_channel: physical nu normalized by the checkpoint training-split mean and population standard deviation
estimator.objective: mean square error between the rollout and the masked sensors on the bursts that start at frames 24, 48, and 72

combined_objective.residual_mse: mean square of the Stage 4 central Burgers residual on sensors32_bursts
combined_objective.selection_metric: arithmetic mean across seeds of mean relative viscosity error

analysis_ceiling.name: oracle_onestep
analysis_ceiling.role: Not a sparse estimator and not a claimed improvement on equal observations. Each input window is the true full field. The loss is still only the masked sensors on that one predicted block. It separates operator error from the sparse initial-window construction.
analysis_ceiling.teacher_forcing: one step from each true window whose output overlaps a scored burst

data_only.retrain: deterministic from that protocol when the checkpoint is absent

hybrid_1e-2.retrain: deterministic from that protocol when the checkpoint is absent

aggregation.unit: one scalar per seed per slice

not_claimed: a retuned hard_ood threshold, sensor mask, or Stage A, B, or C protocol
a change to any previously reported number
that the sparse estimator sees the field off the sensors32_bursts mask
that the 3-frame quadratic fill is a solution of Burgers
that the oracle one-step ceiling uses only the sparse mask as input
a learned inverse network, an architecture search, or a new hybrid weight
that one seed is the result
that a positive lambda was scored on test when validation preferred another value, except lambda 0 which is always scored
